title: tooling(skills): check-doc-json-fences gains a skills/objectui/** leg — the strict authoring face judges the published guides, 8 deliberate counter-examples declared (objectui#12204)
body:
Fixes #12204
Clause-②: no

## What this PR does

`scripts/check-doc-json-fences.mjs` gains a fourth `SCAN_SURFACE` leg: every `.md` page under `skills/objectui/` (16 pages, 70 json/jsonc fences on this branch), anchor `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`. The strict authoring face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`, read from the built `@object-ui/types` `./zod` entry — the face `objectui validate` uses) now judges the node documents a customer's agent copies from the published guides. The maintainer's ruling: 「B2:扩 doc-json 门禁一条腿(推荐)」 — option B of objectui#12135's 速读终稿.

Untouched, as ruled: `scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs`, its `MARKER` (`os:check`), its `MARKED_FLOOR` (70 json), every `os:check` marker line, the three existing legs, the RESOLUTION / REFUSES / ACCEPTS controls, the face resolution, every fence's content. No new gate; no workflow change — `doc-snippet-types.yml` already runs `check:doc-json` on pull requests after the filtered build (read; the existing wiring test pins it).

## The adjacency conflict, measured, and the one rule added

Every json/jsonc fence under `skills/objectui/` carries the `os:check` HTML-comment line DIRECTLY above it (census on BASE `54159d3`: 70 of 70 fences, none inside a blockquote), and `check-skill-examples.mjs` requires exactly that adjacency (its header: 「Marker ADJACENCY is strict, and an orphan is a failure」). This gate's declaration must also be the nearest line above the fence. Only one line can be directly above.

Measured on BASE with `scanJsonFences` over a fixture — declaration line, then the `os:check` line, then the fence: `attached=false consumed=[false]`. The declaration dangled and the fence stayed undeclared; a page could not carry both gates' lines above one fence.

The rule added, inside this gate only: when the line directly above a json/jsonc fence is the `os:check` opt-in line at the fence's quote depth, the attachment walk steps over that ONE line and reads the line directly above it — three contiguous lines at one depth. Nothing else is stepped over on that path: a blank line, prose, a second opt-in line, an opt-in line that is not itself directly above the fence, or a declaration at another quote depth all leave the declaration dangling (and the fence refused). The opt-in spelling lives in this gate as `SKILL_OPT_IN_LINE`, spelled rather than imported — an import would couple this gate's attachment rule to the sibling's module and its `typescript` import; the test file pins it equal to `check-skill-examples.mjs`'s `MARKER`, so a drift is a red test rather than a silent detachment of every declaration under the bundle. `check-skill-examples.mjs` is not touched.

Same fixture after the rule: the trio attaches (`attached=true consumed=[true]`, also inside a blockquote at one depth); every other separation still reads `attached=false consumed=[false]`.

## The deliberate counter-examples — the gate's own output decided

Leg added, no declaration yet — `pnpm check:doc-json` exit 1:

    ❌  JSON doc fences: 8 finding(s) — the strict authoring face is the face `objectui validate` judges with.
      skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md:33 card · :45 text · :424 list · :548 text · :554 text · :611 text
      skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md:120 card · :173 data-table
    scan surface: … · every .md page under skills/objectui/ (16 page(s)) — 240 page(s), 322 json/jsonc fence(s)
    judged node documents: 252 — 238 accepted, 6 declared fragment(s) the face refuses as declared, 8 refused
    not judged: 0 not JSON · 3 not an object · 55 without a string `type` · 12 with a `type` no node schema declares

The same 8 the card predicted, all deliberate. The leg's own buckets — 70 fences, 48 node documents, 18 without `type`, 3 not an object, 1 unresolved `type` (`module`, in `guides/plugin-development.md`) — equal PR objectui#12138's measurement. The keyword stays `fragment`: the gate's header already names 「a deliberately refused example that shows the error」 as a kind of fragment, so no sibling keyword was minted — one keyword, the reason says the kind.

Each gets one declaration line in the gate's existing HTML-comment spelling, directly above the `os:check` line. Sample, `rules/protocol.md`, the WRONG card:

- Before — three lines: the bold lead-in `**❌ WRONG — renders an empty card:**`, the `os:check` HTML-comment line, then the fence.
- After — four lines: the lead-in; an HTML-comment line reading `doc-json: fragment — deliberate counter-example: a title parked under props never reaches the card renderer, and props is no declared key`; the `os:check` line; then the fence.

(HTML-comment lines are spelled in words in this body because the sanitizer eats tag-shaped text.) Every reason says what the example deliberately shows; none claims a check (the gate applies `VERIFICATION_CLAIM`; the shortest reason is 108 characters against the 12 minimum); none cites an issue number, the bundle's rule.

After the eight declarations — `pnpm check:doc-json` exit 0:

    judged node documents: 252 — 238 accepted, 14 declared fragment(s) the face refuses as declared, 0 refused
    controls: RESOLUTION, REFUSES, ACCEPTS hold over 205 node type(s); anchors content/docs/blocks/forms.mdx read, packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md read, README.md read, skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md read
    ✅  Every judged JSON node document on the scan surface passes the strict authoring face.

Baseline on BASE (three legs): 224 pages, 252 fences, 204 judged, 198 accepted, 6 declared, 0 refused, exit 0.

## Sibling gate, unchanged

`node scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs` on BASE and after: `Semantic phase: 18 of 18 ts fence(s) judged, 0 failed.` · `JSON phase: 70 fence(s) parsed, 0 failed.` · `Every marked skill example holds up against the built types.` Its `--self-test`: 60 cases pass, before and after.

## Line budget — `skills/objectui/**`, the PM's ceiling of +8

| file | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` | 640 | 646 |
| `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` | 375 | 377 |
| bundle, every `.md` under `skills/objectui/` | 4815 | 4823 |

+8 exactly: the eight declaration lines and nothing else.

## Tests and gates — final commit `8ebcd56`

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-doc-json-fences.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-skill-examples.test.ts`, under the shared verify lock: `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 158 passed (158)`. New pins: the scanner's three-line step-over in both directions (attached; dangling for a blank line, prose, a second opt-in line, a displaced opt-in line, another depth, a non-json fence); the opt-in spelling equal to the sibling's `MARKER`; RED for an undeclared refused fence under `skills/objectui/`, named at its line; GREEN for a declared one through the opt-in line; dangling plus refused for every other separation; stale through the opt-in line; the leg walks `.md` under `skills/objectui/` only, last, in sorted order, and no other skills tree; the skills anchor is on the leg and owed; the real bundle's declared pages orphan none of the sibling's opt-in lines (`scanSkillFences`). The existing CLI-door parity pin (`validateAuthoredDocument`) now runs over the corpus with the leg, and the `it.each(SURFACE_ANCHORS)` pin covers the skills anchor.
- Ablation after the commit, through the objectstack checkout's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1→0 and marker 0→1 on disk, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): with the one-line step-over disabled, the test file reds 4 of 45 — the step-over pin, the GREEN declaration-through-opt-in pin, the stale-through-opt-in pin, and the real-bundle orphan pin's non-vacuity guard — and `check:doc-json` exits 1 with 16 findings: 8 dangling declarations plus the same 8 refused.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts` exit 0; `--listFiles` includes the test file.
- `node scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs` ✅ 89/90 resolve, 1 baselined · `node scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` exit 0 · `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` ✅ 8459 tracked files · `node scripts/check-shell-escape-residue.mjs` ✅ · `node scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` 0 new · `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ✅ no changeset owed · changeset guards (claims / fixed / no-major / overwrite) ✅.
- Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the rest of the farm: CI's run, not measured here.

## Also touched

`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` — the page that inventories the gates said 「Three legs」 and listed `skills/**` as not read; it now says four and names the declaration shape. Not governed and published by no package; the existing wiring test pins only the script name and path there.

## Acceptance notes

- `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` carries one jsonc fence whose `type` is `module`, which no node schema declares; the gate counts it in the unresolved bucket and judges nothing — it is a plugin-manifest example, not a node document. Observation only, no card.
- `.changeset/12204-doc-json-skills-leg.md` is an empty-frontmatter changeset: `skills/**`, `scripts/` and `content/docs/` sit in no package's `files[]`. objectui has no `skip-changeset` label; none was minted.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 门禁 `check-doc-json-fences`(`pnpm check:doc-json`)多扫一条腿:`skills/objectui/` 下全部 `.md` 页面里的 json/jsonc 节点文档,用 `objectui validate` 同一张严格面判定。这些示例是客户的 agent 通过 `npx skills add` 装进自己仓库后照抄的样板。为了与既有的 `os:check` 标记共存,门禁学会越过紧贴围栏上方的那一行 `os:check`、往上再读一行声明;八个故意写错的反例各加一行声明,写明它故意展示什么。围栏内容、`os:check` 标记、`check-skill-examples` 门禁本身一字未动。

**为什么改。** 维护者 2026-10-12 点名「B2:扩 doc-json 门禁一条腿(推荐)」。此前这 70 个围栏只被要求「能解析」,不被要求「合法」:客户 agent 照抄一个不合规的键,`objectui validate` 会拒,而发布面上没有任何东西提前拦住。现在同一张严格面在发布前就判。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 代价是 `skills/objectui/**` 净增 8 行(4815 → 4823),全是渲染为空的 HTML 注释,读者看不见。风险:今后在这两份指南里新增一个故意写错的例子,门禁会红,作者需要加一行声明 —— 这正是门禁的用途;门禁对每条声明逐次重判,例子一旦变合法,声明即报过期,只减不增。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个 commit;不涉及发版、不动任何包。

**席位意见。** (留空,席位定稿)

**你要做的。** 本 PR 命中受管面 `skills/**`,停在 draft 等一条获授权的 APPROVED review;批准后由认领席翻 ready、入队。你只需判断:八行声明的措辞是否准确描述了各反例故意展示的错误(见上方 sample 与 diff)。
